nodes.description: IEtherFreaker instance held by Freakonomics, hard-coded to 0x3A275655586A049FE860Be867D10cdae2Ffc0f33
immutable address payable owner of Freakonomics, assigned from tx.origin in the constructor
immutable keccak256 of FreakerBirther creation code + bytes12(0) + tx.origin, used for CREATE2 address derivation
IEtherFreaker instance held by FreakerBirther, pointing at the same EtherFreaker contract
FreakerBirther constructor(address payable owner) payable: calls _etherFreaker.birthTo with msg.value then selfdestructs to owner
Freakonomics constructor: sets owner = payable(tx.origin) and computes initCodeHash from tx.origin
birthingCost() public view: prices the next 8 birth certificates from EtherFreaker data
findSet(uint8) public view: brute-forces 8 best FreakerBirtherInfo candidates and total cost
birthSet(uint8) public payable: reparses the same candidate search then CREATE2-deploys 8 FreakerBirther contracts and forwards the balance to owner
_findCaller(uint256) internal view: derives the CREATE2 deployment address from initCodeHash
_randomishIntLessThan(bytes32,address,uint256) internal view: keccak256(block.timestamp, caller, salt) % n pseudo-randomness
tx.origin, used to set owner and inside the initCodeHash preimage
block.timestamp, used as the only varying entropy in _randomishIntLessThan
external payable call _etherFreaker.birthTo{value: msg.value}(owner) performed inside the FreakerBirther constructor
selfdestruct(owner) executed in the FreakerBirther constructor with the owner supplied at construction
low-level call owner.call{value: address(this).balance}("") in birthSet, with assembly revert on failure
CREATE2 deployment new FreakerBirther{salt: bytes32(freakers[i].creationSalt), value: cost}(owner) in birthSet
external call _etherFreaker.middlePrice() used to compute per-birth cost in findSet and birthSet
external view calls _etherFreaker.numTokens() and _etherFreaker.birthCertificates(index) inside birthingCost
address payable owner parameter of the FreakerBirther constructor
uint8 minimumFortune parameter of findSet
uint8 minimumFortune parameter of birthSet
uint256 creationSalt parameter of _findCaller used in the CREATE2 preimage
bytes32 salt parameter of _randomishIntLessThan
address caller parameter of _randomishIntLessThan
uint256 n parameter of _randomishIntLessThan, the modulo bound
foundFreakers counter local to findSet
creationSalt counter local to findSet
caller address local to findSet holding the _findCaller result
species local to findSet, derived from _randomishIntLessThan(species)
fortune local to findSet, derived from _randomishIntLessThan(fortune)
cost local to findSet computed from middlePrice()
FreakerBirtherInfo[8] memory freakers array local to birthSet
foundFreakers counter local to birthSet
creationSalt counter local to birthSet, reused as the CREATE2 salt
species local to birthSet
fortune local to birthSet
cost local to birthSet used as the deployment value
bool ok local to birthSet capturing the low-level call success flag
totalCertificates local to birthingCost derived from _etherFreaker.numTokens() - 8

edges.reason: Freakonomics constructor writes owner from tx.origin, so the privileged owner depends on an untrusted origin.
tx.origin flows into the constructor and determines who becomes owner.
tx.origin is part of the initCodeHash preimage used for CREATE2 address prediction.
block.timestamp is the only varying entropy input of _randomishIntLessThan, making it timestamp dependent.
fortune is produced by timestamp-dependent pseudo-randomness and drives the candidate selection.
species is produced by timestamp-dependent pseudo-randomness and drives the candidate selection.
n bounds the modulo of the pseudo-random result.
caller is mixed into the randomness hash.
salt domain-separates the randomness hash per attribute.
findSet calls _randomishIntLessThan for every candidate, inheriting the timestamp dependency.
birthSet calls _randomishIntLessThan for every candidate, inheriting the timestamp dependency.
findSet calls _findCaller to derive candidate deployment addresses.
birthSet calls _findCaller to derive candidate deployment addresses.
_findCaller reads initCodeHash to compute the CREATE2 address.
creationSalt is hashed into the predicted CREATE2 address.
_findCaller returns the predicted address that is stored in caller.
foundFreakers counts accepted candidate freakers inside findSet.
creationSalt is incremented per candidate inside findSet.
caller holds the candidate CREATE2 address inside findSet.
species is a selection local of findSet.
fortune is a selection local of findSet.
cost is accumulated inside the findSet pricing loop.
minimumFortune gates which findSet candidates are counted as found.
findSet calls middlePrice() to price the prospective birth set.
the middlePrice() result is scaled into the cost local.
the freakers array stores the best FreakerBirtherInfo per species in birthSet.
foundFreakers counts accepted candidates inside birthSet.
creationSalt is incremented per candidate inside birthSet.
species is a selection local of birthSet.
fortune is a selection local of birthSet.
cost is accumulated inside the birthSet pricing loop.
minimumFortune gates which birthSet candidates are counted as found.
birthSet calls middlePrice() for each per-birth cost.
creationSalt is used as the CREATE2 salt when deploying FreakerBirther.
birthSet deploys eight FreakerBirther contracts through CREATE2.
the CREATE2 deployment executes the FreakerBirther constructor.
birthSet requires msg.value to cover birthingCost().
birthingCost queries numTokens and birthCertificates on the external EtherFreaker.
totalCertificates is derived from _etherFreaker.numTokens() - 8.
the birthingCost local totalCertificates drives the whole price calculation.
birthSet forwards the entire balance with a low-level call to owner.
owner is the recipient of the low-level value transfer and can execute code during it.
ok captures the success flag returned by the low-level call.
owner's fallback can reenter birthSet while the balance transfer is executing.
FreakerBirther constructor forwards its msg.value to _etherFreaker.birthTo.
FreakerBirther constructor self-destructs to the owner supplied at construction time.
the owner constructor parameter is the selfdestruct beneficiary.
the owner constructor parameter is passed as the birthTo recipient.
birthTo is invoked on the FreakerBirther _etherFreaker instance.
numTokens/birthCertificates are called on the hard-coded EtherFreaker instance.
middlePrice is called on the hard-coded EtherFreaker instance.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter is only used as the selfdestruct beneficiary and birthday recipient, so it collapses into the selfdestruct operation.
Threshold parameter has meaning only inside findSet.
Threshold parameter has meaning only inside birthSet.
Salt parameter is consumed only by the CREATE2 address helper.
Salt parameter only feeds the pseudo-random hash of this helper.
Caller parameter only feeds the pseudo-random hash of this helper.
Modulo bound parameter is used only by this helper.
Loop counter local scoped to the findSet search.
Candidate salt local scoped to the findSet search.
Local holds the predicted address produced for findSet.
Species selection local scoped to findSet.
Fortune selection local scoped to findSet.
Cost accumulator local scoped to the findSet pricing loop.
Candidate result array local scoped to birthSet.
Loop counter local scoped to the birthSet search.
The local is consumed as the CREATE2 salt of the FreakerBirther deployment.
Species selection local scoped to birthSet.
Fortune selection local scoped to birthSet.
Per-birth cost local used as deployment value inside birthSet.
The local only stores the success flag of the low-level owner call.
Local derived from EtherFreaker data and used only for the birthingCost pricing math.
